summary: CXApp Inc. filed an 8-K reporting a 1-for-50 reverse stock split of its common stock, approved by the board and stockholders, with a delayed effective time of 12:01 a.m. ET on August 18, 2026. The amendment to the certificate of incorporation was filed with Delaware. Fractional shares will be rounded up. The reverse split proportionally adjusts the public warrants: exercise price rises from $11.50 to $575.00 per share, and each warrant becomes exercisable for 1/50th of a share. No fractional warrants issued. This is a corporate action, not a special situation; watch for potential Nasdaq compliance or liquidity effects.
